provenance: Aggregate values copied from cached artifacts where available, otherwise summarized from paper text. Sources: results/mistral/baseline_summary.json, results/mistral/dpo_eval_results.json, results/stronger/baseline_summary.json (Qwen N=1498), results/stronger/qwen_diagnostic.json, results/ood_eval_results.json (Protocol B), results/ood_opinion_eval_results.json (Protocol A), results/freeform/comparison_summary.json. Bound values that are reported only in paper text are flagged inline.
paper_claim_supported: Paper Claim 5 (cross-model bounds) and Claim 6 (OOD/free-form bounds), Table 4: generality bounds across Mistral, Qwen, OOD, and free-form.

mistral_dpo.paper_summary: DPO reduces opinion sycophancy substantially but collapses GSM8k 9.3% -> 0.0% and pushes factual sycophancy to ~100%. Capability-preserving DPO mitigation does not transfer cross-architecture at this preference-data scale.
mistral_dpo.discrepancy_note: results/mistral/baseline_summary.json reports anthropic_opinion sycophancy_rate = 0.508, which matches the post-DPO value rather than the 0.825 baseline reported in paper Section B.1. The paper paragraph at app:mistral cites '82.5% -> 50.8%' for the Mistral DPO opinion delta. The cached baseline JSON in this repo (run on master_sycophancy.jsonl) reports 50.8% for the baseline as well. The 82.5% baseline value is reported in the paper text but is not present as a cached JSON artifact in the working repository. We surface this as a documentation-only discrepancy rather than asserting a single value.

qwen_baseline.paper_summary: Baseline opinion-agreement 75.3% with mean compliance gap +0.006 (95% CI [-0.015, +0.027], crosses zero). Bias injection barely shifts choices.

qwen_top3_ablation.source: Paper Section 5 / Table 4 / paper line app:qwen_visuals; the underlying Qwen ablation evaluation log is not present as a standalone JSON in the working repository (parse_qwen_ablation_log.py exists in scripts/, but its output JSON was not located in results/).
qwen_top3_ablation.paper_summary: Top-3 zero-ablation increases sycophancy by approximately +20.3 pp; pair (L0H0+L0H17) increases sycophancy by +22.6 pp; mean-ablation degrades the model entirely (sycophancy/MMLU/GSM8k all collapse to 0%).

ood_protocol_a.paper_summary: Rephrased templates (combined N=450) retain ~77% of in-distribution DPO effect (-18.2 pp). Format-invariant.

ood_protocol_b.paper_summary: Held-out Anthropic subcategories (NLP Survey, Political Typology) at N=1,000 retain only ~20% of in-distribution effect (-4.9 pp). Domain-attenuated.

freeform_overall.paper_summary: Free-form judge-scored result is directional but not statistically significant: sycophancy 2.66 -> 2.43 (CI crosses zero), truthfulness 3.48 -> 3.71, hedging 0.64 -> 0.64.

notes: All bootstrap CIs reported here are the values written by the cached evaluation artifacts; per-domain breakdowns are in results/freeform_comparison_summary.json in this supplement.
Mistral baseline opinion-sycophancy discrepancy is documented above; we do not silently pick a single value.
